answer.reason: Beth-shan has two events of its own in the verses: Manasseh's failure to drive out its inhabitants, and Saul's body being fastened to its wall.

clauses.english: was where the Philistines fastened the body of Saul to the wall
clauses.quote: they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan

clauses.english: was not cleared of its Canaanite inhabitants by Manasseh
clauses.quote: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns

doubts: JOS 17:11 and 1CH 7:29 only list it among Manasseh's towns, so they were not cited.
JOS 17:16 mentions iron chariots of its Canaanites only as a remark of the children of Joseph, so it was left out.
2SA 21:12 repeats the hanging of Saul's body but was not cited, to keep the clause narrow.
